newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 6.49 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 6.49 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 98-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.49 percent versus 6.907 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 182-day treasury bills was 6.745 percent versus 7.118 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for NZ$50 million of 406-day treasury bills was 7.159 percent versus 7.555 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
